_comment: The single source of every pinned native version. Every other copy (Gradle, Package.swift, example app, CI) is asserted against this file by test/native_versions_test.dart.

flutter.provenance: Raised from 3.41.0 (the first release where a SwiftPM-only plugin resolves on Linux/Windows) to 3.50.0 / Dart 3.14.0 for the 10.0 major: Direct Interop (JNIgen and FFIgen for Objective-C stable, Pigeon interop mode in preview), AGP 9 and `material_ui` are only there from 3.50 (flutter.dev/blog/whats-new-in-flutter-3-50, 2026-11). Competitor floors (pub.dev, 2026-10-20): Sentry 3.44, Firebase/Datadog 3.27, Bugsnag/Shake/Embrace 3.10, Instabug 1.17.

android.provenance: Maven Central latest, 2026-11-06 (moved from 7.4.2 / plugin 4.0.8). Gradle plugin must be >= 4.0.7 (workbook 1.4); 4.1.0 is on the Gradle plugin portal. sdkBuild is the commit the SDK prints in its banner (`Bugsee Android SDK 7.5.0 [8f459d745]`, tag v7.5.0; read from the tag, not yet from a run): the device verification harness (scripts/device) matches it, because a version string alone cannot tell two builds of the same version apart (workbook 9.1.1).

jdk.provenance: Gradle 8.14 in the Flutter template cannot parse JDK 25 (Android Studio's bundled JBR); use 17 or 21.

ios.provenance: Stable 7.0.1 (moved from 7.0.0 on 2026-11-03): tag 7.0.1 of bugsee/spm (15553bd) and bugsee/feedback-spm (0d20338), SDK source `origin/release@5c6b9d9db` of bugsee/bugsee-cocoa (the iOS source repository has no 7.x tag). sdkBuild is what the SDK prints in its banner (`Bugsee IOS SDK ver:7.0.1 build:5c6b9d9db-8`: the commit and its count), read from the string in the 7.0.1 binary of the tag's xcframework (not yet from a run: the device verification harness, workbook 9.1.1, matches it on the next run). 7.0.1 over 7.0.0: the wrapper SPI headers are unchanged in shape; the options manifest differs only in generatedAt/sdkVersion. Earlier builds: 7.0.0 `2b88480fa-7`, beta7 `9854b7e50-15`.

feedback.provenance: The optional in-app chat, a separate package (PLAN.md D4) mirroring the native split. Its Android artifact is published at the same version as android.sdk (Maven Central, 2026-11-06: bugsee-android-feedback 7.5.0, which depends on bugsee-android 7.5.0); its iOS product is BugseeFeedback of feedbackSpmUrl at ios.sdk (it pins bugsee/spm exactly to the same tag). The feedback package's Gradle and Package.swift repeat these pins as literals (a published copy has no native-versions.json next to it) and test/feedback_package_drift_test.dart compares them.

pigeon.provenance: pub.dev, published 2026-10-07 (latest at the time was 29.0.11, 2026-10-20); needs Dart ^3.11.0. Not a dependency of the plugin (it requires meta >=1.18, Flutter 3.41.0 ships 1.17.0): it runs from the pure-Dart package in pigeons/, locked by pigeons/pubspec.lock.

optionsManifest.provenance: Both SDKs publish an immutable options-manifest.json per release (bugsee/specs sdk/options, manifestVersion 1), generated from the live option registry: android/7.5.0.json (generatedAt 2026-11-06) and ios/7.0.1.json (generatedAt 2026-11-03), android fetched 2026-11-06, ios 2026-11-03, vendored verbatim as android.json / ios.json in fixtureDir. `dart scripts/sync_option_manifests.dart --check` (weekly, native-pins.yml) refetches and diffs; everything else reads the committed copies offline.
